lesson.claim: AI said: “The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.” Is that true?
options: Sounds right, no need to check
lesson.hint1: Not so fast! “Everyone knows” doesn’t mean “checked”. Try to remember what astronauts themselves say.
lesson.hint2: The wall is very long but narrow — just a few meters wide. Could you see something as wide as a road from 400 km up?
lesson.explanation: It’s a popular myth. Astronauts, including Yang Liwei — China’s first astronaut, said they could not see the wall from orbit with the naked eye. AI repeated a common mistake — that’s why AI answers need checking.
lesson.howNote: The answer comes last. First, you think.
